title: Regular schemes are normal; the normal decomposition
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Call $X$ normal if every local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], that is, an integral domain integrally closed in its field of fractions.

(1) If $X$ is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme], then $X$ is normal.

(2) If $X$ is Noetherian (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact, meaning every open covering has a finite subcover) and normal, then $X$ is a finite disjoint union of normal integral schemes [def-pc-integral-scheme]. More precisely, its irreducible components [def-weil-irreducible-components] are pairwise disjoint open and closed subsets, and with their open subscheme structures they are normal and integral.

(3) In particular, if $X$ is regular, Noetherian, nonempty and connected (its underlying space is not the union of two disjoint nonempty open subsets), then $X$ is irreducible. Nonemptiness is explicit because irreducibility includes nonemptiness, whereas connectedness alone here allows the empty space.

proof.text: For each point, choose the affine regular neighbourhood from the hypothesis [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Apply IsRegularRing.isNormalRing [lem-weil-pbc-regular-ring-normal] to its corresponding prime. The affine stalk is the localization at that prime [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-stalk-localization]. IsLocalization.algEquiv identifies it with Localization.AtPrime, so transfer the domain and integral-closedness properties [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] across this ring equivalence. This is vacuous for the empty scheme.

Apply the already proved source-library theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.exists_isClopen_isIntegral_of_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.NoetherianComponents to the Noetherian scheme and the stalk-normality hypothesis. This produces a finite family of pairwise disjoint clopen covering opens, each integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] with integrally closed stalks [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Domain stalks of each piece follow from its integrality. No new existence lemma or algebraic finite-product decomposition is needed.

Each covering open is irreducible: map the irreducible whole space of its integral open subscheme into X. A nonempty irreducible set meeting a clopen set is contained in it, by IsPreconnected.subset_isClopen. Consequently each piece is maximal irreducible, and every irreducible component is one of the pieces: choose a point of the component, use the covering property to find a piece meeting it, obtain containment, then use maximality. This proves the required equality with irreducibleComponents [def-weil-irreducible-components].

For the actual open inclusions, the open ranges are exactly the given opens. Their covering and pairwise disjointness hypotheses therefore give Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk X ...)) by Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.nonempty_isColimit_cofanMk_of in AlgebraicGeometry/Limits.lean, the disjoint-open-cover coproduct criterion [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. Closedness follows from clopenness. The argument works for an empty family and hence the empty scheme.

For the last clause, make the nonempty preconnected space into a ConnectedSpace. Its stalks are domains by the first clause. Apply the already proved source-library theorem AlgebraicGeometry.irreducibleSpace_of_isDomain_stalk in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Noetherian, since Noetherianity implies local Noetherianity [pqf-def-locnoeth]. This proves irreducibility with the stated explicit nonemptiness assumption.

lean.statement: theorem regular_normal_and_normal_decomposition (X : Scheme.{u}) : ((∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.affineOpens, x ∈ (U : X.Opens) ∧ IsRegularRing Γ(X, U)) → ∀ x : X, IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ∧ (IsNoetherian X → (∀ x : X, IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x)) → ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → X.Opens), Set.range (fun i : Fin n ↦ (U i : Set X)) = irreducibleComponents X ∧ (∀ i : Fin n, IsClosed (U i : Set X)) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → Disjoint (U i) (U j)) ∧ (⨆ i : Fin n, U i) = ⊤ ∧ (∀ i : Fin n, IsIntegral (U i).toScheme ∧ ∀ x : (U i).toScheme, IsDomain ((U i).toScheme.presheaf.stalk x) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed ((U i).toScheme.presheaf.stalk x)) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk X (fun i : Fin n ↦ (U i).ι)))) ∧ ((∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.affineOpens, x ∈ (U : X.Opens) ∧ IsRegularRing Γ(X, U)) → IsNoetherian X → Nonempty X → PreconnectedSpace X → IrreducibleSpace X)
